**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback insert).**

- **Investigation:** No insurance language exists anywhere — targeted searches for "insurance", E&O/general liability/workers' compensation/certificates, and data/hosting terms returned no hits. I read the full General Provisions block (Sections 10.1–10.8, p0059–p0070), the Article 1–5 operative sections, and the preamble; the miscellaneous article runs notices → no joint venture → assignment → waiver → governing law → severability → survival → entire agreement → headings, with no coverage covenant.
- **Why the rule applies:** HDI "shall host and maintain the Site on a server provided by HDI" (p0007) and, in performing the Services, "may have access to or be exposed to … Content, user information, data" of the Company (p0048) — a hosting vendor touching our data, which is walk-away territory with zero insurance.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at p0070 adding new Section 10.9 carrying only the two fallback elements (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000). No survival tail, at-own-expense language, CGL limits, workers' compensation or certificate mechanics were volunteered, since those sit at the preferred level and are not required by the selected checklist. Redline validated (`ok:true`, minimality gate passed); the preferred limits are offered in the comment as a negotiating alternative.
